UAE Defeats Malaysia in First T20 International Match

The United Arab Emirates (UAE) secured a victory over Malaysia in the first match of a three-game T20 International series. The match was part of the UAE-In-Mal-3-T20is-2026 series. Live scores and results were provided for the contest.
